command.title: Search
command.description: Jump to any page or receptionist.

save.failed: We couldn't save your changes. Try again.

shared.servicesHint: Your receptionists share these services. A change here reaches every receptionist that books them.
shared.knowledgeHint: Your receptionists share this knowledge. A change here reaches every receptionist that uses it.

behavior.description: How this receptionist greets people, what it follows, and how it sounds.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Only you and your team see this name.

greeting.label: Greeting
greeting.hint: The first thing callers and website visitors hear.

voiceInstructions.label: Instructions for calls
voiceInstructions.hint: What the receptionist should do and say on the phone. Leave empty to use the standard instructions.
voiceInstructions.placeholder: Ask for the caller's name first. Mention our spring promotion.

chatInstructions.label: Instructions for website chat
chatInstructions.hint: What the receptionist should do in the chat on your website. Leave empty to use the standard instructions.
chatInstructions.placeholder: Keep answers short and link to our booking page.

tone.label: Tone
tone.hint: A few words, for example warm and direct.

language.label: Language
language.hint: The language it starts in. Callers can still switch.

knowledge.description: Pick which of your business knowledge this receptionist uses. New knowledge is on for every receptionist.
knowledge.listDescription: Turn off anything this receptionist shouldn't talk about.
knowledge.empty: Your business has no knowledge yet. Add some under Knowledge.

booking.description: Whether this receptionist books appointments and which services it can book.

descriptions.instant: The receptionist checks your calendar and books the appointment.
descriptions.request: The receptionist collects the details and your team confirms the time.
descriptions.off: The receptionist answers questions and takes messages but doesn't book.

allowCancel.label: Let callers cancel
allowCancel.hint: Callers can cancel an appointment after the receptionist checks who they are.

allowReschedule.label: Let callers reschedule
allowReschedule.hint: Callers can move an appointment after the receptionist checks who they are.

requireOtp.label: Text a code first
requireOtp.hint: Callers confirm a code sent to their phone before any change.

booking.servicesDescription: Turn off services this receptionist shouldn't book.
booking.servicesEmpty: Your business has no services yet. Add some under Services.

transfers.description: When this receptionist passes a call to a person, and the rules it follows.

mode.label: Transfer calls
mode.hint: When the receptionist sends a caller to your team.

number.label: Transfer number
number.hint: The phone that rings when a call is transferred.
number.invalid: Enter a full phone number, including the area code.
number.missing: Add a number so transfers have somewhere to go.

transfers.rulesDescription: Extra instructions only this receptionist follows.

numbers.description: The phone numbers and website widget this receptionist answers.
numbers.empty: No number or widget goes to this receptionist yet.
numbers.phoneRoute: Calls and texts to this number
numbers.widgetRoute: Chats and calls from your website
numbers.defaultNote: This receptionist also answers anything you haven't assigned to another one.

overview.description: A quick look at this receptionist. Start a test call to hear it.
